d:
The Thunder defeated the Clippers, 108-101 tonight in Oklahoma City. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 34 points along with 6 rebounds and 5 assists for the Thunder, while Ajay Mitchell tallied 18 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Darius Garland recorded 16 points, 11 assists and 4 rebounds. The Thunder improve their record to 3-0 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-2 for the season.
